method: After setup (seed + goto /app) only page.keyboard.press/type were used. After every key the focused element, its computed outline/box-shadow and rect were read with page.evaluate; focus rings were inspected in full-resolution clipped screenshots.

tasks.discoverability: The sidebar '+' beside PROJECTS is the fourth tab stop and is named 'New project', so it is quick to find by keyboard, but the inline form does not take focus and creation drops focus to the page body.

steps.expect: First Tab lands on a skip link or the brand, then the sidebar.
steps.observed: Theme button, Home, Projects toggle, New project '+'. No skip link. Browser default focus ring (outline:auto) visible on each.

steps.expect: One more Tab would go somewhere new inside the project area.
steps.observed: Went to Calendar (empty project list), came back to New project.

steps.expect: Enter opens a name field with the caret in it.
steps.observed: Inline form (Project name textbox + Create) appeared but focus stayed on the '+' button.

steps.expect: Tab reaches the name field.
steps.observed: Textbox focused with visible white ring; text entered.

steps.expect: Enter creates the project and focus lands on the new project's heading or its sidebar entry.
steps.observed: Project created and app navigated to /projects/project-…; document.activeElement became BODY (focus lost).

tasks.verification: Reloaded the page: sidebar lists 'Garage clear-out' and the workspace h1 reads 'Garage clear-out'.

tasks.discoverability: I opened Kitchen expecting an add-workstream control near Kitchen; the only one is the '+' under the root's WORK heading, 13 tab stops after the Kitchen link. The dialog then defaults Parent to Home renovation, so Kitchen must be chosen explicitly.

steps.expect: Kitchen is reachable in the sidebar project tree.
steps.observed: Kitchen page opened; focus stayed on the sidebar Kitchen link (good).

steps.expect: A control to add a workstream near Kitchen.
steps.observed: Passed Cabinets, Garden, Calendar, Search, Settings, project nav root link, gear, breadcrumb, Home, Todos, Archive, Reflections, then 'Add workstream' (+). Focus ring changes from browser default to a 2px orange outline on the gear and +.

steps.expect: Dialog opens with the name field focused.
steps.observed: Dialog 'Add workstream' opened, Name focused with orange ring. Parent preset to 'Home renovation' although I was on Kitchen.

steps.expect: Type name, Tab to Parent, ArrowDown picks Kitchen.
steps.observed: Parent became Kitchen; helper text updated to 'Inside Kitchen'.

steps.expect: Tab reaches Create.
steps.observed: Cancel then Create; Enter created the workstream, dialog closed and focus returned to the Add workstream button. Inline notice 'Created "Lighting"…' appeared in the header.

tasks.verification: Reloaded: project navigation and sidebar show Lighting indented under Kitchen.

tasks.discoverability: There is no 'add section' control visible until a hidden insertion point receives focus; I found 'Insert before Markdown' as the 20th tab stop after the Kitchen link. Each section adds Move/Collapse/Rename/Remove/Resize stops, so reaching anything in the canvas costs many Tabs.

steps.expect: Open Kitchen from the sidebar.
steps.observed: Kitchen opened, focus kept on sidebar link.

steps.expect: An 'Add section' control somewhere after the header.
steps.observed: After sidebar, project nav, workstream links, disabled-looking 'Nothing to undo'/'Nothing to redo' (still focusable), More project actions, the 20th stop was 'Insert before Markdown' (a full-width line with a '+' that only appears on focus). I overshot by 3 into Move/Collapse/Rename Markdown.

steps.expect: Go back to the insertion point.
steps.observed: Back on 'Insert before Markdown'; orange outline clearly visible.

steps.expect: Dialog with type choice focused.
steps.observed: 'Add a section' dialog; Section type select focused (Markdown preselected).

steps.expect: Choose Task List, name it, create.
steps.observed: Section 'Shopping' created above Markdown; focus returned to the insertion point, which now sits below the new section.

steps.expect: Shift+Tab reaches the new list's task field.
steps.observed: Resize Shopping slider, Add task, then the 'Add a task' textbox (white ring visible).

steps.expect: Enter adds a task and keeps the caret in the field.
steps.observed: Both tasks added; focus stayed in the field. Unrequested: a Task details drawer opened for the newly added task, narrowing the list.

steps.expect: Tab reaches the first new task's checkbox.
steps.action: Tab x3 (overshoot to 'Paint, open details'), Shift+Tab
steps.observed: Add task button, Complete Paint checkbox, Paint title; back to checkbox.

steps.expect: Space completes Paint.
steps.observed: Checked; label became 'Reopen task Paint'; focus kept.

steps.expect: Reach Bulbs checkbox.
steps.observed: Paint title, Delete task Paint, Complete Bulbs; Space checked it; progress rose to 75%.

tasks.verification: Reloaded: checkboxes 'Reopen task Paint' and 'Reopen task Bulbs' are checked in the Shopping section. Separate verification on a fresh seed (focus set by script, not counted) confirmed that pressing Enter in a Task List's add field opens the details drawer for the new task.

tasks.discoverability: The dashboard lists the four overdue tasks but they are plain text, not focusable, so the keyboard user has to go through the sidebar and then tab through the whole canvas. After opening details, the drawer's fields come only after every remaining task row.

steps.expect: Overdue tasks on the dashboard are links to the task.
steps.observed: Today › Overdue items are listitems with text and a time; no link or button. Tab never stops on them.

steps.expect: Open Client migration from the sidebar.
steps.observed: Workspace opened; focus kept on sidebar link.

steps.expect: Reach the first overdue task title.
steps.observed: 26 stops to the 'Export legacy records, open details' title (sidebar 4, project nav 4, header 3, Markdown section 7, Task List section chrome 5, add field 2, checkbox 1); overshot by 3.

steps.expect: Back to the title.
steps.observed: Title focused, white ring tight around text.

steps.expect: Enter opens details and the date field is near.
steps.observed: Drawer opened beside the list; focus stayed on the title (by decision). Selected row loses its overdue red tint.

steps.expect: Tab moves into the drawer.
steps.observed: Tab first walked Delete + the 4 remaining rows (13 stops), then Close task details, Title, Priority.

steps.expect: Date field next.
steps.observed: Native date input, month segment selected (mm/dd/yyyy).

steps.expect: Typing segments sets the date and saves.
steps.observed: Value 2026-09-01; row immediately showed 'Due 2026-09-01' without Enter or blur; Undo labelled 'Updated "Export legacy records"'.

tasks.discoverability: 'Remove section Markdown' is announced clearly once focus reaches the section, and focus moves straight to the notice's 'Open Archive'. Getting it back by keyboard means a route change that drops focus, a full re-walk of the project navigation, and a Restore control placed after the row's links.

steps.expect: Open Kitchen and Tab to the first section's remove control.
steps.observed: Reached 'Remove section Markdown' at stop 24, overshot one to 'Edit Markdown for Markdown'.

steps.expect: Back to Remove.
steps.observed: Remove (trash) focused with orange outline.

steps.expect: Enter removes it and offers a way back.
steps.observed: Section removed; floating notice 'Removed the Markdown section. Undo is in the header.' with focus on 'Open Archive'. The notice overlays the Progress section's content.

steps.expect: Open Archive shows the removed section with a restore action, focus on the page.
steps.observed: Navigated to Home renovation Archive; activeElement = BODY.

steps.expect: Tab reaches the Markdown item's restore action.
steps.observed: Tab restarted at the project navigation (root link, gear, 4 pages, Add workstream, 3 workstreams), header Undo/Redo/More, then 'Work canvas' and 'Open Kitchen history' links, then 'Restore saved content for Markdown' (top right of the row).

steps.expect: Enter restores and keeps focus in the list.
steps.observed: Restored; header notice 'Restored the Markdown section was recorded in Kitchen's history.'; activeElement = BODY.

tasks.verification: Opened /projects/project-kitchen: section headings now include Markdown (at the end of the page, as the archive row said).

tasks.discoverability: The 'Edit' button is visible and well named ('Edit Markdown for Markdown'), but it is the 25th stop after the Kitchen link because six chrome stops precede it. The editor is fully keyboard operable and focus returns to Edit after Save.

steps.expect: Reach the Markdown section's Edit button.
steps.observed: Edit was stop 25; overshot to 'Resize Markdown' slider.

steps.expect: Edit opens a text editor with focus inside.
steps.observed: Textarea 'Markdown source for Markdown' focused with orange outline; Preview / Save / Cancel below.

steps.expect: Replace text and reach Save.

steps.expect: Enter saves and returns to the rendered section.
steps.observed: Rendered text updated; focus returned to Edit.

tasks.verification: Reloaded: 'Order appliances first.' present once on the Kitchen page.

tasks.discoverability: Nothing says 'shortcut' until the Add a section dialog is open; the 'Add shortcut' button sits before the focused Section type field, so it is reached with Shift+Tab. In the picker every button is just 'Add'.

steps.expect: Insertion point opens the add dialog.
steps.action: Tab x6, Enter, Tab x20, Enter
steps.observed: 'Add a section' dialog, Section type focused.

steps.expect: Some option for 'shortcut' in the dialog.

steps.expect: A list of sections elsewhere in the project.

steps.expect: Tab to the Task List from Home renovation · Home.

steps.expect: Enter adds the shortcut and returns focus to where I started.

tasks.discoverability: The gear is named 'Project page settings for Home renovation' and is the second stop in the project navigation, so it is found quickly; the panel opens below the four page links, and each checkbox toggle throws focus away.

steps.expect: Open Home renovation and reach a settings control.
steps.observed: Gear button focused (orange outline).

steps.expect: Enter opens page settings with focus inside.
steps.observed: 'Pages' panel opened beneath the page links; focus stayed on the gear (aria-expanded=true).

steps.expect: Tab reaches the Reflections toggle.

steps.expect: Find the checkbox again.

steps.expect: Settings in the sidebar.
steps.observed: /settings with 'AI & Agents' and 'Archived projects' links; focus kept on sidebar Settings.

steps.expect: AI & Agents shows permissions and a connect button.
steps.observed: /settings/agents lists Claude, Cursor, Retired assistant with permission checkboxes and Revoke; activeElement = BODY after the route change.

steps.expect: Somewhere on the page a 'Connect agent' control.
steps.observed: Only 14 checkboxes and 2 Revoke buttons, then focus wraps to BODY and the top bar. Checkbox and Revoke names repeat per agent without the agent name.

steps.expect: Maybe the development panel can add one (dead end).
steps.observed: Panel's Agent connection region is read-only (Copy token). Escape closed it and focus went to BODY.

tasks.verification: Seeing permissions: done (agent list visible). Connecting a new agent: not possible; a complete Tab pass of /settings/agents found no such control.

probes.observed: Tab cycles Name, Parent, Cancel, Create and wraps to Name; Escape closes and returns focus to Add workstream.
Enter opens the inline panel, focus stays on the trigger; Escape closes it but focus goes to BODY.
Enter on Move Markdown then ArrowDown moved the section; a status region announced "Moved Markdown to position 2 of 6."; focus stayed on the grip and remained visible.
